title: The Battle Against Velgar | RuneScape: Dragonwilds #6
author: Sacks of Wine
description:
After hours of preparation, today's finally the day... we're taking on Velgar, our first dragon.

Before the battle, we finish gathering everything we'll need by crafting poison food, brewing potions, and exploring more Dragonkin Vaults to collect the remaining Sanguine Urns from every region we've unlocked.

With our gear upgraded, our magic prepared, and our health fully increased, it's finally time to climb the tower and face Velgar himself.

Can we bring down our first dragon?

In this episode:

🧪 Crafting poison food & potions
🏛️ Exploring more Dragonkin Vaults
❤️ Collecting every available Sanguine Urn
🐉 The battle against Velgar
📖 Progressing the main story

👍 If you're enjoying the series, don't forget to Like and Subscribe!
